title: Final Expression for Variance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the mean square deviation of energy, showing it equals kT^2C_V.

title: Fractional Variance Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must demonstrate the relationship between the variance and the energy of a macroscopic system, leading to the conclusion that the fractional variance approaches zero as N increases.

title: Correct Use of Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the partition function to derive the internal energy and its relation to the heat capacity.

title: Understanding of Heat Capacity
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the significance of C_V in the context of energy fluctuations in thermal equilibrium.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation, particularly in the final expressions.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of the variance and its relation to energy.

title: Missing Factors in Derivation
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as k and T, are included in the final expressions.
